subject.title: [Bug]: Managed Memory Dreaming Promotion cron silently NO_REPLY since 2026-05-09 (jobs.json lastRun stays null)

question: How should managed memory-core Dreaming cron surface per-workspace failures or no-op sweeps after the SQLite cron-state migration?
rationale: Current source shows plugin-local failedWorkspaces handling can coexist with a handled outer cron result, and deciding whether that should become cron error, degraded diagnostics, or logs-only changes operator semantics and retry behavior.

options.title: Add degraded diagnostics without hard failing cron
options.body: Expose failed/no-op Dreaming sweeps through structured Dreaming/doctor/cron diagnostics while preserving scheduler success for cases where the cron handoff itself worked.

options.title: Mark failed workspaces as cron errors
options.body: Propagate any workspace failure into cron lastRunStatus/error so retries and failure alerts activate, accepting stronger runtime behavior changes for existing installations.

options.title: Keep logs/events only
options.body: Treat plugin-level Dreaming failures as internal details and leave cron status as ok, accepting that operators may need manual log or event inspection to notice silent memory staleness.

recommendation.title: Add degraded diagnostics without hard failing cron
recommendation.body: Expose failed/no-op Dreaming sweeps through structured Dreaming/doctor/cron diagnostics while preserving scheduler success for cases where the cron handoff itself worked.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision spans the SQLite Dreaming-state migration and cron status semantics, both areas with recent steipete history.
